replacements.La Máquina de Turing: qué significa comp: The Turing Machine: what it means to compute
replacements.Un modelo abstracto con tres elementos —: An abstract model with three elements — tape, head, and rule table — capable of simulating any possible computation. And also of proving which computations are impossible.
replacements.Celdas con símbolos: 0, 1 o vacío. Es la: Cells with symbols: 0, 1, or blank. This is the memory.

replacements.La máquina lee una cadena binaria de der: The machine reads a binary string from right to left and adds 1, propagating the carry. Press Step-by-step or Run.
replacements.Cualquier proceso de cálculo mecánico pu: Any mechanical computation process can be described with these three pieces. If an algorithm exists, a Turing Machine can execute it.
replacements.No existe ningún algoritmo que determine: There is no algorithm that can determine, for every program and input, whether that program will ever terminate. The limits of computation are mathematical, not practical.
